items.title: Expanding access to safer AI with Amazon
items.summary: Amazon will invest up to $4 billion in Anthropic and become its primary cloud provider, with models trained on AWS Trainium and Inferentia.
items.summaryZh: # 与亚马逊一起扩大对更安全人工智能的访问 今天，我们宣布亚马逊将向 Anthropic 投资高达 40 亿美元。该协议是更广泛合作的一部分，旨在开发业内最可靠、高性能的基础模型。
